caption: A gymnast performs a back handspring, landing cleanly on their feet on a padded floor.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Gymnast in handstand, legs extended — initiation phase complete. Unknown: Whether push-off occurs, air rotation, or landing follows.  
INTERACTION: Hand push-off → backward momentum → tucked position → backward rotation → body extension → foot landing.  
PERSISTENCE: Momentum from push-off sustains rotation; body extension precedes landing; bent-knee absorption terminates motion.  
INTERVENTION: Absent push-off → no rotation → no extension → no clean landing; absent extension → landing instability → loss of control.
